_comment: Read at runtime by /herbal-engine-2 and any other vanilla-JS surface that needs the Covenant framework. Source of truth lives in src/data/covenant.ts — if you change it there, mirror the change here. (Until a build script syncs them automatically, this file is the runtime canonical for non-React pages.)

layers.name: Biological
layers.description: Active compounds, pharmacology, metabolism, dose-response, half-life, receptor binding, long-term effects, toxicity thresholds.

layers.name: Human
layers.description: Age, sex, weight, genetic polymorphisms, existing conditions, current medications, allergies, baseline state, microbiome.

layers.name: Environmental
layers.description: Source organism identity, growing region, soil quality, harvest method, contaminants, processing, sustainability, traceability.

layers.name: Behavioural
layers.description: Sleep, diet, stress, hydration, activity, sun exposure, social rhythm, substance use, screen time, breath, recovery.

layers.name: Ethical
layers.description: Informed consent, realistic expectations, dependency risk, transparency, disclosure, stop conditions, monitoring access, exit dignity.

layers.name: Covenant
layers.description: Autonomy, flourishing contribution, dignity preserved, relationship to nature, lineage respect, generational impact.

axes.title: Active compound identity
axes.description: Which molecules are actually doing the work.

axes.title: Pharmacological mechanism
axes.description: Receptor binding, enzyme modulation, ion-channel activity.

axes.title: Metabolic pathway
axes.description: Which enzymes process it. Which metabolites it becomes downstream.

axes.title: Bioavailability
axes.description: How much of the dose reaches the target tissue.

axes.title: Half-life
axes.description: Time to half-peak. Determines dosing rhythm.

axes.title: Dose-response curve
axes.description: Linear, hormetic, or inverted-U.

axes.title: Receptor affinity
axes.description: How tightly, selectively, reversibly it binds.

axes.title: Long-term effects
axes.description: What happens at month three, year one, decade two.

axes.title: Tolerance development
axes.description: Does the body adapt.

axes.title: Withdrawal profile
axes.description: What happens when use stops.

axes.title: Synergistic cascades
axes.description: Whole-organism effect of combinations within the same biomass.

axes.title: Toxicity threshold
axes.description: Dose at which damage begins. Acute and cumulative.

axes.title: Age
axes.description: Developmental, adult, geriatric.

axes.title: Sex and hormonal state
axes.description: Menstrual cycle, pregnancy, andropause, menopause.

axes.title: Body composition
axes.description: Weight, lean mass, fat distribution.

axes.title: Genetic polymorphisms
axes.description: CYP2D6, CYP3A4, COMT, MTHFR.

axes.title: Existing conditions
axes.description: Comorbidities reshape every risk-benefit calculation.

axes.title: Current medications
axes.description: The single largest source of catastrophic interactions.

axes.title: Allergy and sensitivity history
axes.description: Asteraceae, salicylates, sulphites.

axes.title: Microbiome state
axes.description: Gut bacteria transform many compounds.

axes.title: Mental health history
axes.description: Personal and family.

axes.title: Reproductive context
axes.description: Trying to conceive, pregnant, breastfeeding.

axes.title: Baseline biomarkers
axes.description: Heart rate, blood pressure, sleep, HRV, fasting glucose.

axes.title: Subjective state
axes.description: Self-reported pain, mood, energy, clarity.

axes.title: Source organism identity
axes.description: Species, strain, sub-variety. DNA verified where possible.

axes.title: Growing region
axes.description: Wild vs cultivated, latitude, altitude, ecological community.

axes.title: Soil and substrate
axes.description: Mineral profile, microbial community, organic content.

axes.title: Growing conditions
axes.description: Sun, rainfall, season, stress events.

axes.title: Harvest method and timing
axes.description: Lunar timing, time of day, lifecycle stage.

axes.title: Contaminants
axes.description: Heavy metals, pesticides, microbial load, aflatoxins.

axes.title: Processing method
axes.description: Drying, milling, solvent and temperature.

axes.title: Storage stability
axes.description: Light, oxygen, moisture, temperature.

axes.title: Batch traceability
axes.description: Specific patch of forest to specific bottle.

axes.title: Sustainability of source
axes.description: Population health of the species in the region.

axes.title: Ethical sourcing
axes.description: Indigenous land rights, fair compensation, protocol respect.

axes.title: Lifecycle accounting
axes.description: Closed-loop spagyrics from bud to ash.

axes.title: Sleep architecture
axes.description: Duration, latency, REM, deep, fragmentation.

axes.title: Diet pattern
axes.description: Macros, micros, meal timing, fasting windows.

axes.title: Stress load
axes.description: Acute and chronic. HPA-axis state.

axes.title: Hydration
axes.description: Volume and mineral content.

axes.title: Physical activity
axes.description: Type, intensity, frequency.

axes.title: Sun and light exposure
axes.description: Circadian anchor. Vitamin D status.

axes.title: Social rhythm
axes.description: Isolation, community, intimacy.

axes.title: Substance use
axes.description: Alcohol, caffeine, nicotine, cannabis, recreational.

axes.title: Screen and information load
axes.description: Blue light, attention fragmentation, news cortisol.

axes.title: Breath patterns
axes.description: Nasal vs mouth, depth, pace. CO2 tolerance.

axes.title: Recovery practice
axes.description: Sauna, cold, breath work, meditation.

axes.title: Work and purpose
axes.description: Sense of meaning. Daily-effort coherence.

axes.title: Informed consent
axes.description: The human knows what it is, what it does, what it may do, what is unknown.

axes.title: Realistic expectations
axes.description: No miracle claims. Outcome stated with uncertainty range.

axes.title: Dependency risk disclosure
axes.description: Whether the formula creates or breaks dependency.

axes.title: Transparency of process
axes.description: How it was made, by whom, with what.

axes.title: Stop conditions
axes.description: The signals that say discontinue and consult.

axes.title: Monitoring access
axes.description: A way to track the effect over time.

axes.title: Side-effect education
axes.description: Common, uncommon, severe.

axes.title: Off-label clarity
axes.description: Where traditional use exceeds modern evidence, gap is stated.

axes.title: Exit dignity
axes.description: No long-term lock-ins. No emotional coercion.

axes.title: Pricing honesty
axes.description: Price reflects cost and care.

axes.title: Autonomy
axes.description: Increases the human capacity to act for themselves, not reliance on the supplier.

axes.title: Flourishing contribution
axes.description: Beyond symptom reduction — does this make the life more whole.

axes.title: Dignity preserved
axes.description: Treats the human as protagonist of their own healing.

axes.title: Lineage and cultural respect
axes.description: Traditions credited, supported, not appropriated.

axes.title: Relationship to nature
axes.description: Reconnects to the ecosystem, or severs the link further.

axes.title: Generational impact
axes.description: Effect on children, grandchildren, downstream ecology.
